title: Successful login submission
description: Verify that a registered user can submit valid credentials.
preconditions: The development APK is installed; a valid confirmed account exists; the Login screen is available.
steps: 1. Launch the app with cleared state | 2. Enter USER1_EMAIL | 3. Enter USER1_PASSWORD | 4. Tap Login
expected_result: The login submission completes without a Maestro command failure.
notes: The authenticated destination is not currently asserted because the destination screen has not been defined.

title: Unconfirmed email warning
description: Verify that an unconfirmed account receives the expected verification warning.
preconditions: The development APK is installed; test@gmail.com exists as an unconfirmed account; the Login screen is available.
steps: 1. Launch the app with cleared state | 2. Enter the unconfirmed email | 3. Enter the password | 4. Tap Login
expected_result: A verification warning and Resend The Confirmation Link are displayed.
notes: The test depends on externally maintained account state.

title: Registered email with wrong password
description: Verify the error shown when a registered account uses an incorrect password.
preconditions: The development APK is installed; USER1_EMAIL identifies a registered account; the Login screen is available.
steps: 1. Launch the app with cleared state | 2. Enter USER1_EMAIL | 3. Enter the wrong password | 4. Tap Login
expected_result: Incorrect password and its explanatory message are displayed.
notes: The fixture assumes 12345 is not the account's valid password.

title: Unregistered email warning
description: Verify the warning shown for an email that has no account.
preconditions: The development APK is installed; test97@gmail.com is not registered; the Login screen is available.
steps: 1. Launch the app with cleared state | 2. Enter the unregistered email | 3. Enter the password | 4. Tap Login
expected_result: The unregistered-email warning and explanatory message are displayed.
notes: The static email must remain unregistered.

title: Invalid email validation
description: Verify client-side validation for a malformed login email.
preconditions: The development APK is installed; the Login screen is available.
steps: 1. Launch the app with cleared state | 2. Enter the malformed email | 3. Enter the password | 4. Tap Login
expected_result: Invalid email address is displayed.
notes: The flow does not explicitly assert that no backend request was submitted.

title: Reset-password link routing
description: Verify that the wrong-password error routes to Forgot Password and preserves the email.
preconditions: The development APK is installed; USER1_EMAIL identifies a registered account; the Login screen is available.
steps: 1. Launch the app with cleared state | 2. Submit USER1_EMAIL with the wrong password | 3. Tap Reset your password
expected_result: The Forgot Password screen opens and displays USER1_EMAIL.
notes: The fixture assumes 12345 is not the account's valid password.

title: Wrong-password errors clear on field change
description: Verify that server errors clear when the user edits the password after a failed login.
preconditions: The development APK is installed; USER1_EMAIL identifies a registered account; the Login screen is available.
steps: 1. Launch the app with cleared state | 2. Submit USER1_EMAIL with the wrong password | 3. Verify wrong-password errors | 4. Select the password field | 5. Erase one character
expected_result: Both server errors disappear and USER1_EMAIL remains visible.
notes: The password-field selector depends on a rendered five-character mask.

title: Login password masked by default
description: Verify that the login password is concealed before the visibility control is used.
preconditions: The development APK is installed; the Login screen is available.
steps: 1. Launch the app with cleared state | 2. Enter Test@123 in Password | 3. Hide the keyboard without tapping the visibility control
expected_result: Eight masked characters are displayed and Test@123 is not visible.

title: Show login password
description: Verify that the login visibility control reveals the entered password without changing it.
preconditions: The development APK is installed; the Login screen is available.
steps: 1. Launch the app with cleared state | 2. Enter Test@123 in Password | 3. Verify the value is masked | 4. Tap the visibility control
expected_result: Test@123 is visible and the masked value is no longer displayed.

title: Hide login password
description: Verify that a visible login password can be concealed again without changing it.
preconditions: The development APK is installed; the Login screen is available.
steps: 1. Launch the app with cleared state | 2. Enter Test@123 | 3. Reveal the password | 4. Tap the visibility control again
expected_result: The password returns to eight masked characters and Test@123 is no longer visible.

title: Forgot-password navigation
description: Verify navigation from Login to Forgot Password.
preconditions: The development APK is installed; the Login screen and Forgot Password control are available.
steps: 1. Launch the app with cleared state | 2. Tap Forgot Password
expected_result: The Forgot Password heading and recovery instructions are displayed.
notes: The shared open-forgot-password component performs the destination assertions.

title: Forgot-password back to login
description: Verify navigation from Forgot Password back to Login.
preconditions: The development APK is installed; the Forgot Password screen is reachable.
steps: 1. Launch the app with cleared state | 2. Open Forgot Password | 3. Tap Back to Login
expected_result: Welcome Back is displayed on the Login screen.

title: Forgot-password user not found
description: Verify the response for a password-reset request using an unknown email.
preconditions: The development APK is installed; test443@gmail.com is not registered; the Forgot Password screen is reachable.
steps: 1. Launch the app with cleared state | 2. Open Forgot Password | 3. Enter the unregistered email | 4. Submit the reset request
expected_result: User not found. is displayed.
notes: The static email must remain unregistered.

title: Send password-reset link
description: Verify that an eligible account can request a password-reset link.
app_route: Launch > Login > Forgot Password > Check Your Mail
preconditions: The development APK is installed; test@gmail.com is eligible for password reset; the Forgot Password screen is reachable.
steps: 1. Launch the app with cleared state | 2. Open Forgot Password | 3. Enter the registered email | 4. Submit the reset request
expected_result: Check Your Mail, the submitted email, and Back to Login are displayed.
notes: The flow verifies the confirmation screen but not email delivery.

title: Check-mail back to login
description: Verify navigation from Check Your Mail back to Login.
app_route: Launch > Login > Forgot Password > Check Your Mail > Login
preconditions: The development APK is installed; test@gmail.com is eligible for password reset; Check Your Mail is reachable.
steps: 1. Launch the app with cleared state | 2. Request a reset link | 3. Tap Back to Login
expected_result: The Login screen is displayed.
notes: The flow identifies Login using the screen subtitle instead of the Welcome Back heading.

title: Check-mail back icon navigation
description: Verify that the back control on Check Your Mail returns to Forgot Password.
app_route: Launch > Login > Forgot Password > Check Your Mail > Forgot Password
preconditions: The development APK is installed; test@gmail.com is eligible for password reset; Check Your Mail is reachable.
steps: 1. Launch the app with cleared state | 2. Request a reset link | 3. Tap the Back control
expected_result: The Forgot Password heading is displayed.
notes: The Back selector may be ambiguous until the control exposes a stable accessibility identifier.

title: Check-mail resend link
description: Verify that the reset-link resend control restarts its cooldown timer.
app_route: Launch > Login > Forgot Password > Check Your Mail
preconditions: The development APK is installed; test@gmail.com is eligible for password reset; the resend cooldown completes within 65 seconds.
steps: 1. Launch the app with cleared state | 2. Request a reset link | 3. Wait for Resend Link | 4. Tap Resend Link
expected_result: A new Resend in countdown is displayed.
notes: The flow verifies the timer reset but not API success or email delivery.

title: Navigate to Create Account
description: Verify navigation from Login to Create New Account.
preconditions: The development APK is installed; the Login screen and Create Account control are available.
steps: 1. Launch the app with cleared state | 2. Tap Create Account
expected_result: Create New Account is displayed.

title: Create Account back to Login
description: Verify navigation from Create New Account back to Login.
app_route: Launch > Login > Create New Account > Login
preconditions: The development APK is installed; the Create New Account screen is reachable.
steps: 1. Launch the app with cleared state | 2. Open Create New Account | 3. Scroll to Login | 4. Tap Login
expected_result: Welcome Back is displayed.
notes: The flow uses a duplicated rendered-text selector for Login.

title: Submit new account request
description: Verify that valid registration data submits a new account request.
app_route: Launch > Login > Create New Account > Confirm Your Email
preconditions: The development APK is installed; the generated email is unregistered; the Create New Account screen is reachable.
test_data: First name: Rajib; Last name: Khan; Generated email: test1000-test9999@gmail.com; Password: Rajib@12; Confirmation: Rajib@12
steps: 1. Launch the app with cleared state | 2. Generate a registration email | 3. Open Create New Account | 4. Fill all required fields | 5. Submit Create Account
expected_result: Confirm Your Email is displayed.
notes: The generated address range is finite and can collide with previously created accounts.

title: Submit an already registered email
description: Verify the warning and login route shown when registration uses an existing email.
app_route: Launch > Login > Create New Account > Login
preconditions: The development APK is installed; USER1_EMAIL is already registered; the Create New Account screen is reachable.
test_data: First name: Rajib; Last name: Khan; USER1_EMAIL; Password: Rajib@12; Confirmation: Rajib@12
steps: 1. Launch the app with cleared state | 2. Open Create New Account | 3. Fill the form with USER1_EMAIL | 4. Submit Create Account | 5. Tap the login link in the warning
expected_result: The registered-email warning appears and the login link returns to Welcome Back.
notes: USER1_PASSWORD is required by the runner but is not used by this flow.

title: Required create-account fields
description: Verify that an empty registration form cannot be submitted.
preconditions: The development APK is installed; the Create New Account screen is reachable; all fields are empty.
steps: 1. Launch the app with cleared state | 2. Open Create New Account | 3. Scroll to the submit control
expected_result: Create Account is disabled.
notes: The flow checks the disabled submit state rather than individual required-field messages.

title: Invalid registration email
description: Verify registration email validation for malformed input.
preconditions: The development APK is installed; the Create New Account screen is reachable.
test_data: First name: Rajib; Last name: Khan; Email: test97; Password: Rajib@12; Confirmation: Rajib@12
steps: 1. Launch the app with cleared state | 2. Open Create New Account | 3. Fill the form with a malformed email | 4. Submit Create Account
expected_result: Invalid email address is displayed.

title: Weak registration password
description: Verify that a weak password does not satisfy registration requirements.
preconditions: The development APK is installed; the Create New Account screen is reachable.
test_data: First name: Rajib; Last name: Khan; Email: test97@gmail.com; Password: weak; Confirmation: weak
steps: 1. Launch the app with cleared state | 2. Open Create New Account | 3. Fill the form with a weak password | 4. Inspect password requirements and submit state
expected_result: Password requirement text is visible and Create Account remains disabled.
notes: The flow does not explicitly assert the visual state of every unmet rule.

title: Registration password mismatch
description: Verify validation when password and confirmation values differ.
preconditions: The development APK is installed; the Create New Account screen is reachable.
test_data: First name: Rajib; Last name: Khan; Email: test97@gmail.com; Password: Rajib@12; Confirmation: Different@12
steps: 1. Launch the app with cleared state | 2. Open Create New Account | 3. Fill the form with mismatched passwords
expected_result: Passwords do not match is displayed and Create Account is disabled.

title: Password requirement progression
description: Verify that progressively valid password input enables account creation.
preconditions: The development APK is installed; the Create New Account screen is reachable.
test_data: First name: Rajib; Last name: Khan; Email: test97@gmail.com; Progressive password ending as rA1@2345; Matching confirmation
steps: 1. Launch the app with cleared state | 2. Open Create New Account | 3. Enter the password in stages | 4. Fill the confirmation | 5. Inspect the submit state
expected_result: Password requirements are displayed and Create Account becomes enabled after valid matching input.
notes: The flow does not assert each requirement changing state individually.

title: Updates and Offers toggle
description: Verify the default and interactive states of the Updates and Offers option.
preconditions: The development APK is installed; the Updates and Offers control is available on Create New Account.
steps: 1. Open Create New Account | 2. Locate Updates and Offers | 3. Verify it is enabled | 4. Toggle it off | 5. Toggle it on
expected_result: The control changes from enabled to disabled and back to enabled.
notes: The flow does not submit the form or verify preference persistence.

title: Create account passwords masked by default
description: Verify that both registration password fields conceal their values by default.
preconditions: The development APK is installed; Create New Account is available.
steps: 1. Open Create New Account | 2. Enter Test@123 in Password | 3. Enter Test@123 in Re-type Password | 4. Hide the keyboard without using either visibility control
expected_result: Both fields display eight masked characters and Test@123 is not visible.

title: Toggle create account password independently
description: Verify that the Password visibility control does not change Re-type Password.
preconditions: The development APK is installed; Create New Account is available.
steps: 1. Enter both password values | 2. Reveal Password | 3. Verify Re-type Password remains masked | 4. Hide Password again
expected_result: Only Password is revealed and concealed; Re-type Password remains masked and both values are preserved.

title: Toggle confirmation password independently
description: Verify that the Re-type Password visibility control does not change Password.
preconditions: The development APK is installed; Create New Account is available.
steps: 1. Enter both password values | 2. Reveal Re-type Password | 3. Verify Password remains masked | 4. Hide Re-type Password again
expected_result: Only Re-type Password is revealed and concealed; Password remains masked and both values are preserved.

title: Password toggles maintain independent states
description: Verify that both registration visibility controls maintain separate visible and masked states.
preconditions: The development APK is installed; Create New Account is available.
steps: 1. Enter both values | 2. Reveal Password | 3. Reveal Re-type Password | 4. Hide only Password | 5. Hide only Re-type Password
expected_result: Both fields can be visible together; each can be hidden without changing the other field or either value.

title: Create team successfully
description: Verify team creation, code copying, invite action, logo replacement, and completion.
app_route: Home > Create a Team > Team Code
preconditions: A valid account can log in; .maestro/assets/team-logo.png exists; Australia is available.
test_data: Generated TEAM_NAME; Country: Australia; Logo: team-logo.png
steps: 1. Log in | 2. Open Create a Team | 3. Enter TEAM_NAME | 4. Select Australia | 5. Create team | 6. Capture and copy team code | 7. Copy invite message | 8. Upload logo | 9. Remove logo | 10. Upload logo again | 11. Continue or manage team
expected_result: The team is created, its code remains available for join cases, logo replacement succeeds, and the final action is accepted.
notes: The current build labels the final action Manage team, does not navigate after tapping it, and does not expose Copied or the full invite message in the accessibility hierarchy.

title: Reject duplicate team name
description: Verify that an existing team name cannot be registered again.
preconditions: TC-32 completed in the same run and TEAM_NAME identifies its team.
steps: 1. Log in | 2. Open Create a Team | 3. Enter TEAM_NAME | 4. Select Australia | 5. Create team
expected_result: Name unavailable. Please enter a unique team name to continue your registration. is displayed.
notes: Depends on TC-32 creating TEAM_NAME.

title: Reject Bangladesh team creation
description: Verify the error returned when creating a team for Bangladesh.
preconditions: A valid account can log in; Bangladesh is available.
steps: 1. Log in | 2. Open Create a Team | 3. Enter BANGLADESH_TEAM_NAME | 4. Select Bangladesh | 5. Create team
expected_result: Creation Failed. is displayed.

title: Search and select a country
description: Verify filtering and selection in the Country bottom sheet.
preconditions: A valid account can log in; Australia and Austria are available.
steps: 1. Log in | 2. Open Create a Team | 3. Open Country | 4. Search for Aus | 5. Verify filtered results | 6. Select Australia
expected_result: Australia and Austria are shown, unrelated countries are hidden, and Australia is selected.

title: Recover from no country search results
description: Verify the Country search empty state and recovery with a valid query.
preconditions: A valid account can log in; Australia and Austria are available.
test_data: Invalid search: NoSuchCountryXYZ; Recovery search: Aus
steps: 1. Log in | 2. Open Create a Team | 3. Open Country | 4. Search for NoSuchCountryXYZ | 5. Verify no results | 6. Clear search | 7. Search for Aus
expected_result: No results found is displayed for the invalid query, then Australia and Austria appear after entering a valid query.

title: Search and select a region
description: Verify filtering and selection in the Select Region bottom sheet.
app_route: Home > Create a Team > Select Region
preconditions: A valid account can log in; Australia and Adelaide South are available.
test_data: Country: Australia; Search and selection: Adelaide South
steps: 1. Log in | 2. Open Create a Team | 3. Select Australia | 4. Open Select Region | 5. Search for Adelaide South | 6. Verify filtered results | 7. Select Adelaide South
expected_result: Adelaide South is shown, unrelated regions are hidden, and Adelaide South is selected.

title: Recover from no region search results
description: Verify the Select Region search empty state and recovery with a valid query.
app_route: Home > Create a Team > Select Region
preconditions: A valid account can log in; Australia and Adelaide regions are available.
test_data: Country: Australia; Invalid search: NoSuchRegionXYZ; Recovery search: Adelaide
steps: 1. Log in | 2. Open Create a Team | 3. Select Australia | 4. Open Select Region | 5. Search for NoSuchRegionXYZ | 6. Verify no results | 7. Clear search | 8. Search for Adelaide
expected_result: No results found is displayed for the invalid query, then matching Adelaide regions appear after entering a valid query.

title: Join team successfully
description: Verify that User 2 can join the team created by TC-32.
app_route: Home > Join a Team > Confirmation > Joined > Home
preconditions: TC-32 completed and saved its team data in artifacts/extracted_data/team-data.json; User 2 credentials are configured.
test_data: USER2_EMAIL; USER2_PASSWORD; persisted TEAM_NAME and TEAM_CODE
steps: 1. Log in as User 2 | 2. Open Join a Team | 3. Enter stored code | 4. Find team | 5. Confirm and join | 6. Open Team Dashboard
expected_result: The TEAM_NAME confirmation is shown, You're in is displayed, and Home is visible after Team Dashboard.
notes: Uses User 2 and the latest persisted TC-32 team data.

title: Reject User 2 joining an existing membership
description: Verify that User 2 cannot join the same team again after joining it in TC-39.
preconditions: TC-39 joined the persisted TEAM_NAME as User 2; User 2 credentials are configured.
test_data: USER2_EMAIL; USER2_PASSWORD; persisted TEAM_NAME and TEAM_CODE
steps: 1. Log in as User 2 | 2. Open Join a Team | 3. Enter stored code | 4. Find team | 5. Confirm and join again
expected_result: An error explaining that User 2 already belongs to the team is displayed.
notes: Live exploration of the current build returned the success screen again, so this case currently exposes a product defect.

title: Cancel team join confirmation
description: Verify that Cancel returns from team confirmation to Join a Team.
app_route: Home > Join a Team > Confirmation > Join a Team
preconditions: TC-32 saved its team data in artifacts/extracted_data/team-data.json.
steps: 1. Log in | 2. Open Join a Team | 3. Enter stored code | 4. Find team | 5. Tap Cancel
expected_result: Join a Team is displayed.
notes: Uses the latest persisted TC-32 team data.

title: Enter a different team code
description: Verify that Enter a different code returns to the code-entry screen.
app_route: Home > Join a Team > Confirmation > Join a Team
preconditions: TC-32 saved its team data in artifacts/extracted_data/team-data.json.
steps: 1. Log in | 2. Open Join a Team | 3. Enter stored code | 4. Find team | 5. Tap Enter a different code
expected_result: Join a Team is displayed.
notes: Uses the latest persisted TC-32 team data.

title: Reject invalid team code
description: Verify validation for a random invitation code that does not identify a team.
preconditions: A valid account can log in.
steps: 1. Log in | 2. Open Join a Team | 3. Enter INVALID_TEAM_CODE | 4. Tap Join Team
expected_result: Invalid invitation code. is displayed.

title: Reject the team creator joining their own team
description: Verify that User 1, who created the team in TC-32, cannot join that team using its invitation code.
preconditions: TC-32 created and saved the team as User 1.
test_data: USER1_EMAIL; USER1_PASSWORD; persisted TEAM_NAME and TEAM_CODE
steps: 1. Log in as User 1 | 2. Open Join a Team | 3. Enter stored code | 4. Find team | 5. Confirm and join
expected_result: An error explaining that User 1 already belongs to the team is displayed.
notes: Uses User 1 and the latest persisted TC-32 team data.
